author: Hermes
question: According to the official GATE 2027 pattern, what is the marks distribution for the EE paper?
solution: For papers including EE (the group excluding AR, CY, DA, EY, GE, GG, MA, PH, RA, ST, XH, XL): General Aptitude 15 marks, Engineering Mathematics about 13 marks, subject questions 72 marks, total 100. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/question_paper_pattern
subject: Exam pattern
